name: dumbbell kneeling to jump box
description: A kneeling-to-feet jump followed by a box jump while holding light dumbbells at your sides.
instructions: Kneel on a padded surface a short distance from a low box, holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Keep the dumbbells close to your body and explosively drive your hips to land on both feet in a squat stance.
Once balanced, jump onto the box and land softly with bent knees.
Stand tall, step down carefully, and reset to kneeling.
